Here we present high angular resolution ($0.12$ arcsec or $\approx11$ pc) Atacama Large Millimeter/submillimeter Array observations of the $^{12}$CO(2–1) line emission of the early-type galaxy NGC 1387.

In this work, we apply the CO dynamical modelling method to estimate the mass of the SMBH at the centre of the galaxy NGC 1387, the data for which were obtained as a part of the mm-Wave Interferometric Survey of Dark Object Masses (WISDOM) project.

The $^{12}$CO(2–1) emission line of NGC 1387 was observed with ALMA in band 6 using both the $12$-m array and the $7$-m Atacama Compact Array (ACA) as a part of projects 2016.1.00437.S (PI: Davis) and 2016.2.00053.S (PI: Liu), respectively.
